title: 第21章 这就要过年了月票加更第22章 正阳门
slug: 方士开局我给秦始皇画大饼
content_zh:
扶苏被这没头没脑的话弄得一怔，见邹云神色古怪，微微蹙眉问道，“大方师，此言何解？”
“哈哈哈哈......”
邹云被扶苏那茫然的模样给逗乐了，方才的惆怅一扫而空。
他大笑着站起身，热情几步上前，不由分说地拉住扶苏的手臂，将其引到烧着炭火的青铜小炉旁。
炭炉上，用陶釜煮的梅干水，正冒着细密小泡。
没有解释方才那句脱口而出的吐槽，邹云只是热络的为其斟上一杯梅浆，并连忙说道。
“毋恙，毋恙！来，扶苏公子快请上座！”
待扶苏坐定，他也不绕弯子，直接开门见山问道。
“公子今日，怎么有空来此仙人观？莫不是陛下又有旨意？”
邹云暗自猜测着，毕竟以扶苏的身份和处境，最近似乎不该能寻常串门。
扶苏放下喝了一口的梅浆，端正坐姿，语气平和地说明来意。
“大方师不知吗？再过几日便是新年岁首，扶苏此来，是奉陛下之命，邀请大方师参与宫中蜡祭大典的。”
在秦朝，腊祭便是一年中，规模最大的祭祀活动。
这是一场，上至皇亲贵胄，下至平民百姓，举国同庆的日子。
在秦朝的森严律法中，也唯有腊日前后，平日对喝酒聚众的限制才被放开。
所以对于腊祭，辛苦一年的民众也翘首以盼。
“新年？”
邹云闻言一愣，下意识望向窗外细雪和光秃秃的枝桠，满脸不可思议。
“这不是刚入冬吗？怎么就过年了？”
此话一出，扶苏不由暗自打量着邹云。

‘莫非是大方师兵解的后遗症，还没完全痊愈？’
扶苏暗叹，就算是他，对于邹云刚兵解的那段疯癫时光，也略有所闻。
不过，扶苏心中虽有疑虑，但面上依旧保持着恭敬，温声解释道。
“大方师潜心修道，想必是闭关日久，不知人间时序流转。岁首之期，确已逼近。”
“哈哈，原来如此，原来如此！”
知道自己闹笑话了，邹云连忙打个哈哈，“确实糊涂了，怎么连新年都忘了，惭愧惭愧！”
他含糊地应付过去，心中暗骂自己历史课没学好。
实际上，这也不能怪邹云，因为秦朝采用的是颛顼历，以十月为岁首。
与现代的春节完全是两码事，而现代人所熟知的春节，要到汉武帝才恢复使用。
所以秦人的新年就在农历十月！
“哦，明白了，岁首蜡祭。”
邹云迅速调整好表情，对着扶苏爽朗一笑。
“承蒙陛下与公子盛情相邀，邹云届时定当准时赴会，与公子一同前往观礼。”
他以为扶苏是来约他同行的，而扶苏脸上，却浮现一抹苦涩笑意。
“恐怕......”
扶苏微微欠身，对着邹云面露歉意道，“恐怕扶苏无法与大方师同行了。”
“这是为何？”邹云不解。
“先前，扶苏鲁莽，在大殿之上力谏陛下...欲处死大方师。然此举已然触怒陛下......”
扶苏深吸一口气，语气平静，却难掩其中失落。
“陛下有旨，命我即日启程，前往上郡，督查长城边军事务，戴罪立功。”

他顿了顿，仿佛在陈述一件与自己无关的事情，脸上平静得漠然。
“所以扶苏，不日便要......离开咸阳城了。”
‘已经进程到这一步了吗。’
content_en:
Fusu was startled by this nonsense. Seeing Zou Yun's strange expression, he frowned slightly and asked, "Master Dafang, what do you mean by this?"
"Hahahaha..."
Zou Yun was amused by Fusu's confused look, and the melancholy just now was swept away.
He stood up with a laugh, stepped forward enthusiastically, took Fusu's arm without any explanation, and led him to the small bronze stove burning charcoal fire.
On the charcoal stove, the prune water boiled in an earthenware cauldron was bubbling with tiny bubbles.
Without explaining the complaint he just blurted out, Zou Yun just poured a glass of plum juice for him warmly and said quickly.
"It's okay, it's okay! Come on, Mr. Fusu, please take a seat!"
After Fu Su sat down, he didn't beat around the bush and asked straight to the point.
"Master, why do you have time to come to this Immortal Temple today? Could it be that His Majesty has another decree?"
Zou Yun secretly guessed that after all, given Fusu's status and situation, it seemed that he shouldn't be able to visit him normally recently.
Fusu put down the plum juice he took a sip from, sat upright, and explained his purpose in a calm tone.
"Don't you know, Grand Master? In a few days it will be the beginning of the new year. Fusu is here on His Majesty's order to invite Grand Master to participate in the wax ceremony in the palace."
In the Qin Dynasty, the wax sacrifice was the largest sacrificial activity of the year.
This is a day when the whole country, from the royal family and nobles to the common people, celebrates together.
Among the strict laws of the Qin Dynasty, restrictions on drinking and gathering in groups were relaxed only around the twelfth lunar month.
Therefore, people who have worked hard for a year are looking forward to the wax festival.
"New Year?"
Zou Yun was stunned when he heard this, and subconsciously looked out the window at the fine snow and bare branches, with a look of disbelief on his face.
"Isn't it just winter? Why is it already the New Year?"
As soon as these words came out, Fusu couldn't help but look at Zou Yun secretly.
‘Could it be that the sequelae of the Dafang division’s military dissolution have not fully recovered? ’
Fusu secretly sighed, even he had heard a little bit about the crazy time when Zou Yungang was defeated.
However, although Fusu had doubts in his heart, he still maintained a respectful expression on his face and explained in a gentle voice.
"Master Dafang devotes himself to cultivating Taoism. He must have been in seclusion for a long time and does not know the flow of time in the world. The period of the year is indeed approaching."
"Haha, that's it, that's it!"
Knowing that he was making a joke, Zou Yun quickly laughed, "I'm really confused. Why did I forget the New Year? I'm so ashamed!"
He dealt with it vaguely, secretly cursing himself for not studying well in history class.
In fact, Zou Yun cannot be blamed for this, because the Qin Dynasty adopted the Zhuanxu calendar, with October as the beginning of the year.
It is completely different from the modern Spring Festival, and the Spring Festival as it is known to modern people was not resumed until Emperor Wu of the Han Dynasty.
So the Qin people’s New Year falls in the tenth month of the lunar calendar!
"Oh, I understand, New Year's Wax Festival."
Zou Yun quickly adjusted his expression and smiled heartily at Fusu.
"Thanks to the kind invitation from Your Majesty and the Young Master, Zou Yun will definitely attend the meeting on time and attend the ceremony with the Young Master."
He thought Fusu was here to invite him to accompany him, but a bitter smile appeared on Fusu's face.
"I'm afraid..."
Fusu bowed slightly and said apologetically to Zou Yun, "I'm afraid Fusu won't be able to go with Master Dafang anymore."
"Why is this?" Zou Yun was puzzled.
"Previously, Fusu was reckless and tried to admonish His Majesty in the main hall... He wanted to execute Master Dafang. However, this move has angered His Majesty..."
Fusu took a deep breath, his tone was calm, but he couldn't hide his disappointment.
"His Majesty has a decree, ordering me to set off today to go to Shangjun to supervise the affairs of the Great Wall border troops and make meritorious deeds."
He paused, as if he was stating something that had nothing to do with him, his face was calm and indifferent.
"So Fusu will...leave Xianyang City soon."
‘Has the process reached this point? ’
